verdict.rationale: Brex's own product pages describe the full loop. Admins set rules for spending, documentation and approvers, and Brex AI applies them to every transaction (brex-docs-8, brex-docs-41). Limits can be set by spend type such as stipends, travel and procurement (brex-docs-9), and localized policies can apply to entities, individuals and departments (brex-docs-45). Out-of-policy purchases are auto-blocked (brex-docs-36), and a review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses while escalating exceptions to people (brex-docs-16). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how policy rules are configured (role and context conditions specifically for expenses; role-based routing is only shown for bill pay in brex-docs-11), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that auto-approval and exception routing work as marketed.
